status: Prespecified full-coverage expansion before any new model fit or full-validation model scoring; prior live subset jobs unchanged

dataset.source_statement: Official pinned README says all278stories are Gutenberg sourced; use all provided edited story/QA files under dataset license, privately, without claiming all translations are public domain worldwide.
dataset.split: Custom source-family cohort, not the official benchmark. All Lang-labelled origins and Andersen validation; Potter/Grimm test; every other origin training, irrespective of official split. This includes official validation/test rows in custom training families and therefore must never be reported as an official-split benchmark.
dataset.prior_exposure: Prior400validation QA already scored; retain every prior validation/test source role. Existing3314train QA already trained. Expanded2372validation cohort contains the observed400 and is not fresh. Custom325test QA remains unopened.
dataset.source_group_rule: Before QA parsing, group normalized identical titles/text or five-token Jaccard>=.8; assign entire groups test>validation>train to retain all human QA without source leakage. Current full audit found no cross-story duplicate edges. Plot equivalence beyond this check remains unknown.
dataset.source_section_rule: One source defect: remarkable-rocket has two adjacent distinct paragraphs with sectionID5. Merge adjacent repeated IDs into one evidence unit retaining every paragraph and original full-text character sequence; reject nonadjacent repeated IDs as ambiguous.
dataset.excluded_QA: None preemptively. Malformed records must fail and be audited explicitly; never silently drop QA to improve metrics.
dataset.privacy: Raw stories, QA, predictions and weights remain private/ignored.

generator.name: google-t5/t5-small
generator.selection: Highest ALL-validation normalized answer tokenF1 among initial/epoch checkpoints; exact ties earliest. No test access until global selection serialized.
generator.hardware_amendment_before_scoring: Account free GPU quota exhausted according to audio submission rejection. No RAG GPU attempt or model scoring occurred. Adapt prospectively to free Kaggle CPU30GB using 60M T5-small, 512-token context and LR1e-4; original BART139M/1024/LR3e-5 plan remains in commit34bfbd6. This changes architecture/context/optimization together for feasibility and is not a controlled BART-vs-T5 superiority comparison. Measure a real CPU smoke before full launch.

retrieval.scope: All sections of the question's story; never supply gold section IDs at inference.
retrieval.baseline: BM25 top 4 sections, source-order assembly, tokenizer truncation at 512 including question; report retained evidence loss
retrieval.learned: Rerank BM25 top 12 with pinned MiniLM cross-encoder, optionally fine-tuned on train positive evidence sections and same-story hard negatives. Nonlinked negatives may contain valid alternative evidence; disclose annotation incompleteness.
retrieval.selection: Validation evidence recall@4; ties choose frozen simpler policy. Report post-tokenization retained evidence recall as well.

evaluation.primary: Macro question answer normalized token F1 on retrieved contexts
evaluation.validation_cohort: ALL2372usable human QA across54validation stories, no per-origin cap or difficulty sampling; report every denominator and any audited defect.
evaluation.references: Nonempty answer 1 and answer 4 only, max over references; report reference-count strata.
evaluation.oracle: Human linked context is a separately labeled diagnostic, never the primary retrieval score.
evaluation.test_gate: Preparation may stage test CSV without human inspection. Training/selection runner cannot parse test questions or gold until validation selection is serialized and hashed. Test evaluation runs once after selection; later reuse is retrospective.
evaluation.no_answer: FairytaleQA is answerable-only. No claim of unknown-question calibration.
evaluation.historical: Dorian, Persuasion, Call of the Wild, Journey and Cask are observed; no selection or fresh claims from them.

resources.compute: Free private Kaggle CPU; no paid compute or GPU-quota bypass
resources.long_run: Full dataset is mandatory, no400QA cap. Measured subset2.7seconds/microstep implies~9hours generator training before full validation decoding. Implement resumable epoch/shard checkpoints with optimizer/RNG/source identity before full launch if normal12hour service ceiling requires multiple legitimate jobs. Do not reduce data for feasibility.
resources.launch: No new full fit until staging/preflight and resume/save/reload mechanism pass. Existing subset T5/reranker jobs stay immutable.

selection: Compare pinned initial generator and epoch checkpoints on ALL2372validation QA with actual answer EM/tokenF1 and distinct retrieval/citation metrics. Future retrieval adaptation uses ALL7883training QA and ALL2372validation QA; no gold injection in primary validation contexts. Select retrieval by declared evidence recall, then verify frozen-generator answer behavior on full validation before final test policy.
limitations: Source fairy tales may have appeared in model pretraining. This study does not prove pretraining decontamination.
Whole collection separation does not guarantee disjoint recurring plots.
Children's narrative adaptation is not proof of adult novel thematic reasoning.
A generated answer with retrieved section citations is not necessarily entailed by them; citation source validity and human-annotated evidence relevance are distinct metrics.
Full custom source-family split differs from official train/dev/test; do not claim official benchmark comparability.
Prior400validation exposure is retained and disclosed; expansion is not an independent validation replication.
